title: How Much Silver Should You Own?

segments.narration: Most financial advisors say 5 to 15 percent of your portfolio should be in precious metals. Timing check: 16 words / 2.5 = 6.4s + 2s = 8.4s minimum. Window is 10s. PASS.

Standard financial guidance puts precious metals at 5 to 15 percent of total portfolio value. Silver typically takes 20 to 40 percent of that slice, depending on your risk tolerance. Most new buyers have no target at all. They buy when they feel like it and end up with a position that has no relationship to their actual financial picture.
